whyEssential.title: Signs You May Need Surgical Tooth Extraction
whyEssential.highlight: You may require a surgical tooth extraction if you experience:
whyEssential.description: Severe tooth pain, impacted wisdom tooth, broken tooth below the gum line, advanced tooth decay, swollen gums around a tooth, dental infection or abscess, loose tooth due to advanced gum disease, or difficulty opening your mouth because of impacted teeth. Early treatment helps prevent infection from spreading and reduces the risk of complications.

items.question: How long does a surgical tooth extraction take?
items.answer: Most surgical extractions are completed within 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the complexity of the case.

items.question: Is surgical tooth extraction painful?
items.answer: No. Local anesthesia is used to numb the area, making the procedure comfortable. Mild soreness after treatment is normal and usually resolves within a few days.

items.question: How long does recovery take?
items.answer: Most patients recover within a few days to one week, although complete healing of the extraction site may take several weeks.

items.question: Who is a suitable candidate for surgical tooth extraction?
items.answer: Patients with impacted wisdom teeth, severely damaged teeth, retained roots, or teeth that cannot be restored may require surgical extraction after a dental examination.

items.question: What is the cost of surgical tooth extraction in Pune?
items.answer: The cost varies depending on the complexity of the extraction, the position of the tooth, and any additional procedures required. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.

items.question: When is surgical extraction recommended instead of a simple extraction?
items.answer: Surgical extraction is recommended when a tooth is impacted, broken below the gum line, has complex roots, or cannot be safely removed using conventional extraction techniques.
